name: Heavy Grinding Stone
summary: A faire attendant asks you to bring Heavy Grinding Stones. Your delivery earns tickets for the faire.

sections.title: At the Faire
sections.body: The faire attendant thanks you and says the stones are already making their muscles grow. In return, you receive tickets and a warning not to eat too many sweets. The attendant wants you to stay strong and ready to fight.

faq.answer: The attendant wants Heavy Grinding Stones.

faq.q: What do I get for bringing the stones?
faq.answer: The attendant gives you tickets for the faire.

faq.q: Why does the attendant mention sweets?
faq.answer: The attendant warns you not to eat too many sweets and says you need to stay in fighting shape.

attribution: In-game quest text: Heavy Grinding Stone
